labels.name: bug
labels.description: Confirmed bug in the engine: reproducible and backed up by the code or by the exact error text

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A well-reasoned proposal: a provider, a service, a capability

labels.name: question
labels.description: A genuine question about how the engine works, not a bug report

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Not confirmable, user error, about the editor rather than the engine, or asking for a service whose terms disqualify it

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Not enough to reach a conclusion: no provider, no model id, no error text, no reproduction steps

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Looks like an already-existing issue or pull request

labels.name: docs
labels.description: About the README or the comments, not about code

labels.name: good-pr
labels.description: A solid pull request: clear diff, follows the conventions, and the host contract is intact

labels.name: needs-work
labels.description: A legitimate pull request with problems: editor logic that belongs in the host, a hardcoded string, a wire format changed without saying so, a load-bearing comment deleted

labels.name: trash
labels.description: Junk: spam, advertising, abuse, no real content, bots

labels.name: spam
labels.description: Flooding: too many issues from the same author in a short time (mechanical antispam, not AI)

labels.name: moderation-removed
labels.description: Content removed automatically: personal data (doxxing) and/or severe targeted abuse (mechanical moderation action, not a quality label)

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Technical fallback label: the model returned a value that is not in this list
